ExpertSelection.description: Safe catalog reference only. Native resolves current verified receipt; the renderer cannot choose paths, hashes, role text or trust.

ExpertRef.description: Native/Host private immutable identity. It conveys no execution or file-access authority.

ExpertDisplay.description: Historical safe identity. No raw resource path, digest, role/knowledge text or credential.

ResourceOperation.description: Closing or abandoning a selection does not undo completed installation. Query the original operation after unknown outcomes. No implicit retry with a new operation.

BindingSetPayload.description: Existing local conversation only. Native owns scope and maps Host/thread IDs. Null explicitly selects ordinary mode. Active/pending approval/unknown outbox rejects before changing any binding. Draft with no native rollout saves intent only and never invokes SwitchThread.

managed.description: True once this conversation enters the expert submission family, including explicit ordinary snapshots or a rejected initial binding attempt. Native owns this routing marker; none/revision0 cannot imply a legacy conversation.

BindingOperation.description: Same scope/operation/full intent replays original receipt. Succeeded means the binding application protocol completed under qualified native lifecycle, not a model quality assertion. Unknown blocks sends and further changes. bindingRevision is the effective confirmed revision: succeeded expected+1; pending/unknown/rejected expected. requestedExpert preserves the original request and is not the effective current binding.

NativeSubmitPayload.description: Versioned wrapper: never attach expert fields to the old closed submit. New chat explicit expert/null with revision zero. Existing chat must exactly match the current binding. Native resolves private hashes and freezes with messages/outbox. Full wrapper participates in idempotency.

TurnExpertSnapshot.description: Private durable snapshot. Digest defined by transport.json ordered LF tuple. Explicit null means ordinary mode; omission is invalid. Full original model/permission/market submission plus this snapshot form one immutable intent.

PrivateSubmission.description: Full expert-aware submission. turnOperationId must equal submission.snapshot.turnOperationId. Existing task/localSession/agentSession distinctions and content/permission/market semantics are unchanged. Native/Host must hash the entire wrapper, never only the market body or expert digest.

PrivateGrantPayload.description: Same Native-owned pipe and hello authority as market control. Original Native authorization must cover chat and selected connectors. One existing grant lifecycle carries the complete typed wrapper; no new bearer, transport or caller-authorized role.

PrivateReceipt.description: Original receipt and exact frozen expert context. Never grant authority or native role hash echo; Runtime does not return an expert digest.

ApplyPayload.description: Only an existing owned thread with real rollout. Under the shared session/model/thread lock recheck expected binding/model/scope/market revision and no active/pending/unknown work. New bindingRevision equals expected+1. Preserve full ordinary baseline/model/permission/market composition. marketSnapshot is last confirmed applied market config, not a new grant or previous-turn capability. Removal uses explicit expert=null and complete ordinary baseInstructions.

ApplyReceipt.description: Host adaptation receipt only, not native role checksum evidence. Pending/unknown retains original intent; read does not restart or execute a turn. bindingRevision is the effective confirmed revision: succeeded equals expectedBindingRevision+1; pending/unknown/rejected retains expectedBindingRevision. expert is the original requested reference/null, not proof it was applied. Native keeps the old current binding until succeeded, and blocks sends while unknown.

Error.description: Only temporarily_unavailable may be retryable, after reading original operation. Outcome unknown never grants automatic retry or replacement identity.

SubmissionReadPayload.description: Read original scoped expert receipt by the actual turn operation. Check owned pipe instance and task/local session mapping. Missing receipt or unknown outcome does not prove unsent, renew a grant or authorize resend. No new native turn.

PrivateBindingRecoverPayload.description: Explicit recovery only. Current outer authority authorizes reconciling the exact immutable original Native intent. Preserve original identity, payload, Host nonce and receipt. Never start a turn or replace the operation.

PrivateResourceRecoverPayload.description: Explicit reconciliation of the original resource operation. Never installs or removes resources. Observe the original managed-core journal; if no core operation began, durably reject the original intent under existing mutation locks. No state inferred from current installation alone.
